card.name: Nutrition and cancer citations and food lists
card.fires_on: Small words or punctuation in diet and cancer text, right before a journal name, citation detail, or a food-related phrase. Examples are the J in JAMA, 'Journal of', and 'top' before 'folic-acid-rich foods'.

modes.label: Journal citations
modes.description: Start of a journal name or author punctuation in reference lists on diet, alcohol or tea and cancer.

modes.label: Lead-in to food phrases
modes.description: Linking words just before a phrase about foods or eating more vegetables and fruits.
modes.example: Here are some of the<< top>> folic-acid-rich foods.

card.writes: It pushes the word food and its variants as the next word, in English and Chinese.
card.plain: It fires in diet-and-cancer writing, on small words just before a journal name or a mention of foods.
